rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four thousand
locative plural indicating the total number
past passive participle describing those afflicted

items.question: What affliction befalls beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: The scope is eighty-four thousand in number.
items.inference: Beings situated in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams suffer torment.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
